text: 🍿 Jackson Lamb meets Dobby, and it works This season, Gary Oldman (Sirius Black in 'Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban' ) shares scenes with Lenny Rush , the 17-year-old cast as Dobby in the HBO 'Harry Potter' . Lamb ends up shielding a kid whose father was murdered. Cute coincidence, sure. 🧙 What I like is that nobody sells it as a stunt. Rush plays a frightened boy opposite the foulest spy in London, and that's a better pitch than any wand-waving. 'Slow Horses' keeps landing sharp casting without begging for attention. 🕵️ ✈️ Add to watchlist

🍿 'Digger' is messy, and Cruise is why it works 📆 Release: October 2, 2026 🎭 Genre: #Comedy · #Satire ✈️ Add to watchlist Alejandro G. Iñárritu returns to English-language filmmaking for the first time since 'The Revenant' , with a "comedy of catastrophic proportions." SlashFilm's early review says his indulgences nearly sink it. That tracks. The 'Birdman' ego-trip energy is right there in the pitch. 🎬 What intrigues me is Tom Cruise as the lifeline. Since 'Tropic Thunder' we know he's game for gleeful self-parody, and an auteur with a big satirical swing needs exactly that anchor. I'm in, with one eyebrow raised.

🍿 Reacher already has a Season 6, and Season 5 isn't even finished Prime Video renewed the show while cameras are still rolling in Toronto on the "Make Me" season. That's not a streamer hedging its bets. I like it. 💪 Alan Ritchson turned a guy who punches people into a reliable global draw, and Season 4 reportedly pulled 66 million viewers in 28 days. That puts Reacher next to 'Bosch' as Prime's longest-running scripted staple. My only worry is formula fatigue, but the one-book-per-season setup keeps it honest. ✈️ Add to watchlist
